canonicalIngredients.name: olive oil
observations: 1/4 cup marinade + 1 tbsp tzatziki + 3 tbsp salad (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: lemon zest
observations: zest of 1 lemon, in reserved sauce (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: feta
observations: 7 oz block in brine, torn into slabs (s3)

causalSequence: cube lamb leg or shoulder 2.5-4 cm
marinate lamb: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano (plus vinegar, mustard, cumin, paprika per source); 4 h to overnight refrigerated
grate cucumber; squeeze or drain dry
stir tzatziki: yogurt, drained cucumber, garlic, olive oil, herbs, vinegar; chill 30 min
chop salad: tomato, cucumber, capsicum, red onion, olives; dress with olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano; top with feta slabs
soak wooden skewers; thread lamb, discard marinade
grill skewers over high direct heat, turning, until charred and medium inside (140-155 F)
rest lamb off heat a few minutes
serve skewers with pita, tzatziki, greek salad
techniqueFacts: all three souvlaki sources marinate 4 h to overnight for preference; one allows 30 min minimum (s2)
acid (lemon juice, wine vinegar) tenderizes the lamb; one source adds yellow mustard as tang plus binder for spices (s1)
two sources squeeze or drain the grated cucumber hard before mixing tzatziki to avoid a watery sauce (s0, s1)
target doneness is medium, 140-155 F internal, with an off-heat rest to finish (s1, s2)
one source reserves half the marinade (never meat-touched) with honey, lemon zest, parsley as a finishing drizzle (s0)
salad dressing is unwhisked: oil and red wine vinegar poured straight over the vegetables (s1, s3)
feta goes on top of the salad in slabs, not tossed through (s1, s3)
wooden skewers get a 10-30 min water soak before grilling (s0, s1, s2)
leg is leaner and easier to cube; shoulder is fattier and more flavourful (s1, s2)
